Fatha printed on the qaf (expected ارْزُقْنِي).
Twice (lines 2 and 4): shadda+kasra printed on the mim of اللهم instead of shadda+fatha; kept as printed. Other اللَّهُمَّ on the page are normal.
Fatha printed on the fa (expected وَمَغْفِرَةً).
Fatha on ta and no shadda on nun (expected مُطْمَئِنَّةً).
Shadda+kasra printed on the ya (expected قَيُّومُ).

No tanween on this شيء, unlike the following شَيءٌ ×3.
Sukun on مِن before the article; no vowel on final ra.
Sukun printed over the lam of the article and no fatha on the hamza; kept as printed.

notes: No footnotes, headings or Quran on pp.053-056 (all fully vowelled dua prose of حزب الفتح الصديقي). p.052 ends with a complete sentence and p.053 opens with an indented line, so p.053 has no '+'; pp.054 and 056 continue the previous page's sentence ('+'); p.055 starts a new indented paragraph. Small alif over final ى (إِلَى، عَلَى، النَّوَى) is the automatic Lotus glyph and is written as plain ى. The print often puts sukun on a long ya/waw (وَإِسْرَافِيْلَ، فِيْمَا، خَطِيْئَتِي، دُوْنَكَ); kept as printed. Marks deliberately absent as printed: الوَهَّاب. ; شيءٍ (p.053, no fatha on shin); شَقيًّا (no kasra on qaf); وَأَسْأَلُك لِسَانًا (no fatha on kaf, p.054); تَعْلَم، ×2; وَأَعْظِم (no sukun); اجْعَل لِّي. p.054 أَصْلِح لِي: a single kasra sits inside the bowl of the final ha and no sukun is printed; read as the lam's kasra (أَصْلِحْ imperative) — reviewer may wish to confirm. p.056 سَلَمًا printed with fatha on sin and lam.
